newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Foreign currency deposits in Philippine banks up.
newsitem.headline: Foreign currency deposits in Philippine banks up.

text.p: Foreign currency deposits in the 48 commerical banks in the Philippines increased to $14.614 billion as of end-January from $14.401 billion at the end of December, the central bank said on Friday.

Central bank deputy governor Edgardio Zialcita sad in a statement that the January-end figure was almost $5.2 billion higher than foreign currency deposits at end-January 1996, which totalled $9.42 billion.
